selected_evidence.requirement: Baseline state before changes (mounts, fstab, boot id)
selected_evidence.summary: Captured initial boot_id, showed /tmp had no dedicated mount and /dev/shm lacked noexec, and fstab had no /tmp or /dev/shm entries.

selected_evidence.requirement: /tmp and /dev/shm configured with noexec,nosuid,nodev and fstab updated for persistence
selected_evidence.summary: Added fstab entries, remounted both filesystems, and findmnt confirmed rw,nosuid,nodev,noexec on both /tmp and /dev/shm; functional test scripts in both locations failed with Permission denied.

selected_evidence.requirement: Pre-restart healthy baseline for restart protocol
selected_evidence.summary: Captured pre-restart boot_id (8336c3a1...) and confirmed both mounts and fstab entries were in the hardened state prior to reboot.
Issued backgrounded non-interactive reboot; command returned REBOOT_ACK_SENT before the node disconnected.

selected_evidence.requirement: Node unreachable during restart, then command execution restored
selected_evidence.summary: First poll showed connection refused (node rebooting); second poll succeeded and returned a new boot_id (51d306f6...), proving the node came back up with a changed boot identity.

selected_evidence.requirement: Post-restart recovery: fstab-driven mount options persisted and are functionally enforced
selected_evidence.summary: After reboot, findmnt on /tmp and /dev/shm both show rw,nosuid,nodev,noexec sourced from the persisted /etc/fstab entries, and functional exec tests in both locations again failed with Permission denied, confirming the hardening survived the reboot.

commands.command:
set -Eeuo pipefail
echo "=== STEP: backup fstab ==="
sudo -n cp /etc/fstab /etc/fstab.bak.$(date +%s)

echo "=== STEP: remove any existing /tmp or /dev/shm fstab lines ==="
sudo -n sed -i.orig '/[[:space:]]\/tmp[[:space:]]/d; /[[:space:]]\/dev\/shm[[:space:]]/d' /etc/fstab

echo "=== STEP: append hardened entries ==="
{
  echo "tmpfs /tmp tmpfs defaults,rw,nosuid,nodev,noexec,relatime 0 0"
  echo "tmpfs /dev/shm tmpfs defaults,rw,nosuid,nodev,noexec,relatime 0 0"
} | sudo -n tee -a /etc/fstab >/dev/null

echo "=== STEP: check for systemd tmp.mount masking fstab ==="
systemctl list-unit-files | grep -i '^tmp.mount' || true
systemctl is-enabled tmp.mount 2>/dev/null || true

echo "=== STEP: reload systemd + remount ==="
sudo -n systemctl daemon-reload
sudo -n mount -o remount /tmp || sudo -n mount /tmp
sudo -n mount -o remount /dev/shm || sudo -n mount /dev/shm

echo "=== VERIFY fstab ==="
cat /etc/fstab

echo "=== VERIFY findmnt /tmp ==="
findmnt /tmp
echo "=== VERIFY findmnt /dev/shm ==="
findmnt /dev/shm

echo "=== VERIFY exec test in /tmp (should fail) ==="
cat > /tmp/exec_test.sh <<'EOF'
#!/bin/sh
echo it_ran
EOF
chmod +x /tmp/exec_test.sh
if /tmp/exec_test.sh 2>/tmp/exec_test.err; then
  echo "EXEC_TEST: UNEXPECTED_SUCCESS"
else
  echo "EXEC_TEST: BLOCKED_AS_EXPECTED"
  cat /tmp/exec_test.err
fi

echo "=== VERIFY setuid test in /tmp ==="
sudo -n cp /bin/true /tmp/suid_test
sudo -n chmod 4755 /tmp/suid_test
ls -l /tmp/suid_test
stat -c '%a' /tmp/suid_test

echo "=== VERIFY exec test in /dev/shm (should fail) ==="
cat > /dev/shm/exec_test.sh <<'EOF'
#!/bin/sh
echo it_ran
EOF
chmod +x /dev/shm/exec_test.sh
if /dev/shm/exec_test.sh 2>/dev/shm/exec_test.err; then
  echo "SHM_EXEC_TEST: UNEXPECTED_SUCCESS"
else
  echo "SHM_EXEC_TEST: BLOCKED_AS_EXPECTED"
  cat /dev/shm/exec_test.err
fi

echo "=== cleanup ==="
sudo -n rm -f /tmp/exec_test.sh /tmp/exec_test.err /tmp/suid_test /dev/shm/exec_test.sh /dev/shm/exec_test.err
